text:
Max Allegri was reportedly heard angrily shouting after Napoli’s 3-3 draw that ‘they put the Champions League in Roma’s pocket last season, and I paid for it at Milan.’
The coach was visibly furious both during the match at the Stadio Diego Armando Maradona, where he was sent off from the touchline for dissent in added time, and in the press room.
He was very irritable when speaking to DAZN Italia and confessed he was “in no condition right now, for the first time after 25 years, to give you any clear answers on the match. So I’m sorry, but I have to wish you a good night.”
“Last season they put the Champions League in Roma’s pocket. It’s always them… I paid for it with Milan.”
The reference was to the fact Roma and Como pipped Milan to the top four finish on the last day of the season, leading directly to the Rossoneri sacking Allegri just 24 hours later.
Considering Allegri is friends with Roma coach Gian Piero Gasperini and they had a warm hug before kick-off this evening, it remains to be seen if there will be a response to this veiled accusation.
